'''Arkanian''' was the language used by the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanians]], especially on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]].

==Overview==
The language of the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] people was developed on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]] before they made contact with the civilized [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When contact with the greater galaxy was established, young Arkanians were taught Arkanian and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], so the majority of the population was bilingual.<ref name="UAA" /> Among the [[Arkanian Offshoot/Legends|Arkanian Offshoots]], a slightly different dialect gradually emerged, emphasizing words of submission and forgetting those of victory or the desire to challenge.

The word ''perero''/''perera'' meant "honored elder," and ''edessa'' meant "triumph."

Despite the language largely being restricted to Arkania, some non-Arkanians took up the language in order to communicate with their friends and companions. Among these were the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] of [[Arca Jeth]]: [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]<ref name="dss">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> and [[Cay Qel-Droma|Cay]] and [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]],<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> along with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lucien Draay]] who did business with the Arkanians.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Several centuries later, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Kueller]] knew the language,<ref name="dss" /> as did the [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]], [[Seeqov Thranx]].<ref name="Thyferra: Bacta Basics">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031106thyferra|text=Thyferra: Bacta Basics|int=Thyferra: Bacta Basics}}</ref>
